description: End-to-end bootstrap for a PHP repository of any of four flavors — a Laravel application, a WordPress plugin, a WordPress block theme, or a PrestaShop module. Resolves `flavor` (`laravel`/`wordpress-plugin`/`wordpress-theme`/ `prestashop-module`) from `args`, from an `iru-explore` `Project type:` line (`php-laravel`, `php-wordpress-plugin`, `php-wordpress-theme`, `php-prestashop-module`) or the same on-disk markers, or asks; then collects the project's identity (name, slug, Composer vendor, PHP namespace, description, license, developer name/email/organization URL) and the shared pipeline parameters (`open-source`, `visibility`, `ci`, `ci-tests`, `pages`, `distribution` with its flavor-specific meaning, `sonar` plus its detail keys, `accessibility` — the automated accessibility level of the browser UI tests every flavor's scaffold writes to `.ui-quality.yml` —, `php-version`, `integration-branch`, `stable-branch`) once, each with visibility-aware cost guidance, and orchestrates the flavor's scaffold skill (`iru-setup-php-laravel` / `iru-setup-php-wordpress` with `flavor: plugin|theme` / `iru-setup-php-prestashop`) → `iru-setup-antora` → `iru-setup-php-gitignore` → `iru-setup-php-github-workflows` → `iru-setup-changelog` → `iru-setup-readme`, in that order, via `iru-isolated-skill-executor`, so nothing is asked twice (the workflows step is skipped entirely when `ci` is `no`). Invoke as `/iru-setup-php-repository`, optionally with `args` (`key: value` lines) pre-resolving `flavor`, `mode` (`new`/`existing`), `open-source`, `visibility` (`public`/`private`/`internal`, detected via `gh` when absent), `ci` (`yes`/`no`), `ci-tests` (`unit`/`full`), `pages` (`yes`/`no`), `distribution` (`none`/`internal`/`store`), `sonar` (`cloud`/`self-hosted`/`none`, + `sonar-organization`/`sonar-project-key`/`sonar-host-url`), `accessibility` (`enforce`/`report`/`off`/`none`, default `enforce`), `php-version`, `integration-branch` (default `develop`), `stable-branch` (default `main`), `on-existing` (`ask`/`keep`/`update`/`replace`, forwarded only when supplied), and every identity key, skipping the matching question. Starts by announcing whether it is setting up from scratch or updating an existing repository (with an inventory of every component it owns marked absent/present/partial); each sub-skill then warns and asks keep/update/replace for whatever it finds, and the final report lists the action taken per component. Use whenever bootstrapping (or catching up) a Laravel, WordPress, or PrestaShop repository's full scaffold/docs/gitignore/CI/changelog/README pipeline in one pass instead of running six skills separately and re-answering the same questions.
